}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients == 
* 3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (720 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) cooked [[Cookbook:Mashed Potatoes|mashed potatoes]]
* 1 tin (425 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Tuna|tuna]], drained
* ¾ cup (180 ml) tinned [[Cookbook:Corn|corn]]
* ¾ cup (180 ml) frozen [[Cookbook:Pea|peas]], thawed and drained
* ½ cup (120 ml) cooked [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], cut into small pieces
* 4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] fresh [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] herbs (e.g. [[Cookbook:Coriander|coriander]], [[Cookbook:Basil|basil]], [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]])
* 1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Chili Paste|chilli sauce]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]], beaten
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]
* 1 cup (240 ml) [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|breadcrumbs]]

== Procedure == 
# Combine all ingredients except breadcrumbs in a large bowl and mix until combined.
# Shape mixture into patties and gently roll in breadcrumbs until well coated.
#Either:
#* Place patties on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking tray]] and cook in a moderately hot [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] (200°C /400°F) for 30–35 minutes, turning once until golden brown and crisp; '''''or'''''
#* Place patties under a moderately hot grill and cook for 8–10 minutes each side until golden brown and crisp; '''''or'''''
#* Heat a small amount oil in a large [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] patties for 5 minutes each side until crisp and golden, drain well and keep warm to serve.
